item.title: 4 men plead guilty to torching 4 London-based ambulances operated by Jewish charity
item.description: Four men have pleaded guilty to destroying four Jewish community ambulances in an arson attack in north London earlier this year that many said was a direct result of the start of the Iran war

item.title: UN agency warns of 17,000 children in urgent need of assistance as aid reaches some Nepal survivors
item.description: Aid has begun to reach survivors of the catastrophic flash floods that swept through the mountainous border region between Nepal and China

item.title: Russian drones batter Ukraine's Kyiv region, hitting apartments and warehouses for a second day
item.description: Russian forces have resumed drone attacks on Ukraine’s Kyiv region, hitting numerous buildings and storage depots

item.title: A theater is reimagining Homer’s Odyssey through the agony of Ukraine’s war
item.description: A new production of the “The Odyssey” in wartime Kyiv reimagines Homer’s epic through the experience of modern Ukraine

item.title: Serbia's president criticizes UN court for not releasing war criminal Mladic to die at home
item.description: Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic has accused a U.N. court of “uncivilized behavior” for denying early release to former Bosnian Serb commander Ratko Mladic

item.title: Quebec’s governing party names Trump its ‘real adversary’ as election begins
item.description: Quebec’s governing party has opened the provincial election campaign by casting U_S_ President Donald Trump as its “real adversary.”
